moat_against: Commodity product — fungible risk capital repriced annually, brokers can move business; no structural pricing power
Price-taker in a softening cycle — property reinsurance rates falling at renewals; competition and third-party capital set price
Catastrophe/geopolitical tail — $201M pre-tax cat losses in Q2 2026 alone; one large event year can erase a year of underwriting profit
Reserve risk — earnings lean on favorable prior-year development ($165M in Q2 2026), which can reverse
Mortgage insurance concentration in U.S. housing credit and GSE/housing-policy risk
moat_for: Disciplined cycle management — shrinking net written premiums (-6.9% YoY Q2 2026) into the soft market instead of chasing share
Diversified three-segment platform — reinsurance and mortgage carried a weak insurance segment in Q2 2026
Leadership in specialty insurance and U.S. mortgage insurance; underwriting expertise and claims capability, not just capacity
Proven returns through a cycle — Q2 2026 annualized operating ROE 15.3% in a deteriorating quarter; OE positive 5 of last 5 FY
Capital return engine — $1.95B buybacks in H1 2026, diluted shares down to 354.2M from 375.9M in FY2025
moat_justification: Top-tier underwriting franchise — disciplined cycle management (shrinking premiums into the softening market), three diversified segments, leadership in specialty lines and U.S. mortgage insurance, mid-to-high-teens operating ROE through the cycle (Q2 2026 annualized operating ROE 15.3%) and aggressive buybacks — capped at moderate because the product is commodity risk capital repriced annually: no structural pricing power, no customer lock-in, returns set by the industry cycle, catastrophe luck and reserve development as much as by the franchise.
name: Arch Capital Group Ltd.
one_liner: High-quality diversified P&C/reinsurance/mortgage insurer, moat 5/10 — engine prints Tier B (weighted IRR 19.05%, IV@15% $126.86 vs $96.04) on a float-capitalizing OCF base, so the final tier is softened to C at low confidence; on engine numbers it clears 15% at ~$127, ~$94 (bear IV) with a margin of safety.
sector: Finance / Property & Casualty Insurance, Reinsurance & Mortgage Insurance
tier_override_reason: SECTOR_MODEL_MISMATCH insurer artifact: the OCF-based OE base capitalizes float/reserve growth (FY2025 OCF $6,172M vs net income $4,399M), so tier-by-numbers B overstates distributable owner's earnings; softened one notch, confidence low — same treatment as HIG.
